title: NCT5532D analog inputs and the SMIOVT1 source report stuck values

owner.description: NCT5532D analog inputs and SMIOVT1 source

description: CPUTIN reads 131 and AUXTIN0 about 197 at idle and under load. The CPUVCORE pin holds 0.264 V while MSR 198 moves between 0.73 and 0.98 V. VIN2 and VIN4 saturate (255, 253). The SMIOVT1 source (bank 6, 21) is 01, a value the datasheet marks Reserved, and its reading stays 50. 3VCC, AVCC, 3VSB, VBAT and VTT are correct. MR9A sets diode mode for CPUTIN (5D=47, 5E=04).
not_established: Stuck values alone do not separate an empty pin from a wrong sensor mode.
remediation: Unwired pins need no firmware change. Separating an unwired CPUTIN from a thermistor read in diode mode (5D=47) needs board inspection or a reversible mode-bit test. No candidate, C3.
